proves.claim: Renewing one member of a block is refused PENDING_REFREEZE when a held peer has a pending criterion correction, and no member's lease or renew event moves.

store.blocks.renew-peer-correction-refus.why: A block-peer renew passes the one claim-move guard its holder check does not cover, so a correction cannot be skipped by renewing through a sibling.

proves.claim: Renewing a claim held through no block renews only that item and writes only its own renew event.

store.blocks.renew-non-member-unchanged.why: The block renewal must not reach items outside a block.
